title.zh: 普通狨：圈养父亲照料研究

description.en: Inspect a Wisconsin National Primate Research Center study of 24 experienced fathers and 62 offspring. Offspring of fathers responsive to infant distress calls had higher survival past one month (p = 0.002) and greater mean weights at weeks 28 and 30. These are findings from one captive colony.
description.zh: 查看威斯康星国家灵长类研究中心的一项研究：24 位有育幼经验的父亲及其 62 只幼崽。会回应幼崽求救叫声的父亲，其幼崽一个月后存活率更高（p = 0.002），第 28 和 30 周的平均体重也更高。这些结果来自单一圈养群体。

limitations: The study concerns one captive Wisconsin colony; it does not estimate wild behavior, geographic distribution or a species-wide effect.
Father responsiveness was classified before offspring outcomes were compared, so the study-level association does not establish causation.
